8074eef8f0.q: What improvements does Dexcom G7 15-day offer compared to G7 10-day in terms of accuracy and user experience?
8074eef8f0.a: The G7 15-day extends sensor wear to 15 and a half days with a 12-hour grace period and includes algorithm improvements that make the glucose graph smoother. The improved algorithm reduces the jittery signal seen on G7 10-day and patients report noticing the improved accuracy. Additionally, a new patch lasts longer with 10% more sensor survival and does not increase skin irritation.

b7582d5c83.q: How does SmartBasil technology help optimize basal insulin dosing for patients with diabetes?
b7582d5c83.a: SmartBasil is in pilot launch across U.S. clinics and automatically titrates basal insulin doses in the background based on CGM data. The system gets patients to their optimal dose quickly, allowing them to see the impact on glucose control. One patient reached optimal dose within 17 days, and both patient and physician can see the results immediately.

8dca1cb266.q: How is Dexcom integrating Clarity data analytics into electronic health records (EHRs)?

Hundreds of hospitals and clinical sites are currently onboarding with the existing integration, and the company plans to continue evolving the EHR integration to provide full Clarity functionality built in.

b27b1ab595.q: What is Nutrisense and how does Dexcom's acquisition enhance CGM-guided nutrition planning?
b27b1ab595.a: Nutrisense is a company Dexcom has agreed to purchase that provides CGM-guided nutrition plans delivered by certified nutritionists. The system helps patients achieve weight loss or metabolic health goals guided by CGM data, creating high engagement scores. Dexcom plans to integrate Nutrisense across all products to offer personalized nutrition plans.
